title: 11 Best Cicchetti Bars in Venice — The Unfiltered Bàcari Guide
description: The best cicchetti bars (bàcari) in Venice — curated from Reddit reviews. Bar All'Arco, Cantine del Vino già Schiavi, Al Mercà, Cantina Do Mori & more. Where locals actually eat, honest verdicts.

places.name: Bar All'Arco

redditQuotes.text: Best Cicchetti: Bar All'Arco. It offers cicchetti using a lot of different seafood — freshest I had in Venice.
redditQuotes.source: — r/travel · A trip in Venice, Italy thread, 2022

redditQuotes.text: All'Arco: the best bacaro in Venice, the most typical. Don't be afraid to ask for recommendations.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Venezia · First time in Venezia thread, 2025

places.verdict: The undisputed #1 cicchetti spot in Venice. Every Reddit thread about cicchetti mentions All'Arco — and for good reason. The crostini change daily based on what's fresh at the Rialto market next door.

comparison.best for: The quintessential Venetian cicchetti experience — fresh, seasonal, perfect
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 1,520 reviews · Daily-changing menu using Rialto market ingredients · Standing room creates authentic bacaro atmosphere
comparison.limitations: Standing room only (few outdoor tables) · Closes by 2:30 PM · Can get crowded midday
comparison.what to order: Baccalà mantecato crostino (the signature), seasonal seafood crostini (ask what's fresh), truffle and cheese crostino. Pair with prosecco (€3) or house white wine.
comparison.insider tip: Go at 10:30 AM when they first open — freshest selection, no crowds. Ask the staff what's best today; they're genuinely helpful and proud of their food.

places.whatToOrder: Baccalà mantecato crostino (the signature), seasonal seafood crostini (ask what's fresh), truffle and cheese crostino. Pair with prosecco (€3) or house white wine.

places.name: Cantine del Vino già Schiavi

redditQuotes.text: Their flavors are bold, creative, and so plentiful that you could come back several times and still not try them all. I personally loved the gorgonzola with pear and sarde in saor.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · 8 Must-Try Spots for the Best Cicchetti in Venice, 2025

places.verdict: The most creative cicchetti in Venice. The display case is packed with an overwhelming variety of crostini — bold, inventive, and so plentiful you could visit five times without trying them all.

comparison.best for: Creative crostini + canal-side eating in the arty Dorsoduro neighborhood
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 2,819 reviews · Massive crostini variety · Canal-side location near Accademia Bridge · Both locals and food tourists
comparison.limitations: Standing room only inside · Gets very busy at aperitivo hour · Cash preferred
comparison.what to order: The famous tuna with cocoa powder crostino (sounds odd, tastes incredible). Also: gorgonzola with pear, sarde in saor, seasonal vegetable crostini. Wine starts at €1.20.
comparison.insider tip: Take your cicchetti outside to eat along the canal — it's one of Venice's most picturesque lunch spots. Visit around 11:30 AM for the best selection before the crowd.

places.whatToOrder: The famous tuna with cocoa powder crostino (sounds odd, tastes incredible). Also: gorgonzola with pear, sarde in saor, seasonal vegetable crostini. Wine starts at €1.20.

places.name: Bacareto da Lele

redditQuotes.text: A glass of wine/spritz or two and several cicchetti and you're good. It's the best way to eat in Venice without spending a fortune.
redditQuotes.source: — r/Venezia · Where to eat in Venice without spending a fortune thread, 2024

places.verdict: The cheapest cicchetti in Venice, and still genuinely good. University students, workers, and budget-savvy locals pack this tiny spot near Piazzale Roma for €1 panini and €0.80 wine.

comparison.best for: Absolute best value cicchetti in Venice — nothing else comes close on price
comparison.strengths: 4.8★ · Incredibly cheap (wine from €0.80) · Opens at 6 AM · Authentic local crowd
comparison.limitations: Tiny window-service spot · Very basic setup — no seating · Near Piazzale Roma (less scenic area)
comparison.what to order: Small panini with mortadella, soppressa, or porchetta (€1–1.50). A glass of wine is €0.80–1.50. Get a few panini and a couple of glasses for under €5.
comparison.insider tip: Perfect first or last stop — it's 2 minutes from the Piazzale Roma bus/tram station. Great for a cheap morning snack before exploring.

places.whatToOrder: Small panini with mortadella, soppressa, or porchetta (€1–1.50). A glass of wine is €0.80–1.50. Get a few panini and a couple of glasses for under €5.

places.name: Al Mercà

redditQuotes.text: Most people stop by Al Merca just to grab a glass of wine or a cocktail. Along with drinks, they also offer a variety of small sandwiches that are simple and tasty.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: A tiny counter near the Rialto market serving great sandwiches and drinks. The line moves fast and the quality-to-price ratio is outstanding. More of a quick-service panini stop than a traditional cicchetti counter, but essential for any Rialto crawl.

comparison.best for: Quick, affordable panini and drinks during a Rialto market visit
comparison.strengths: 4.7★ from 1,171 reviews · Inexpensive · Great drinks · Fast service
comparison.limitations: Primarily panini rather than traditional cicchetti display · Can have long lines · Standing only
comparison.what to order: Small sandwiches (simple, tasty), a glass of prosecco or house wine, or a spritz. Everything is affordable and fresh.
comparison.insider tip: Combine with Bar All'Arco — they're a 2-minute walk apart. Hit All'Arco for cicchetti, Al Mercà for a spritz.

places.whatToOrder: Small sandwiches (simple, tasty), a glass of prosecco or house wine, or a spritz. Everything is affordable and fresh.

places.name: Cantina Do Mori

redditQuotes.text: Cantina Do Mori is a fun and cozy spot with a distinctly Venetian charm. It's supposedly the oldest bacaro in Venice and feels like an Italian version of a pub, complete with copper pots hanging from the ceiling.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: Venice's oldest bacaro — open since 1462. Copper pots hang from the ceiling, the counter is worn smooth by centuries of elbows, and the cicchetti are deeply traditional. This is the bacaro for atmosphere and history.

comparison.best for: History, atmosphere, and a taste of centuries-old Venetian tradition
comparison.strengths: Oldest bacaro in Venice (560+ years) · Incredible atmosphere · Great baccalà and fried items · Long hours (8 AM – 7:30 PM)
comparison.limitations: Limited seating · Can feel touristy during peak hours · Slightly higher prices than hole-in-the-wall spots
comparison.what to order: Baccalà mantecato, fried zucchini flowers (seasonal), roasted potatoes, and a francobollo (tiny stamp-shaped sandwich). House wine by the ombra.
comparison.insider tip: Go early morning (8–9 AM) when it's just locals having their first ombra of the day. The evening crowd is more tourist-heavy.

places.whatToOrder: Baccalà mantecato, fried zucchini flowers (seasonal), roasted potatoes, and a francobollo (tiny stamp-shaped sandwich). House wine by the ombra.

places.name: Basegò

redditQuotes.text: Basego is a modern take on the bacaro — great cicchetti and wine in the Castello neighborhood, away from the Rialto crowds.
redditQuotes.source: — YouTube · WHERE TO EAT IN VENICE: The Ultimate Cicchetti & Bacari Guide, 2024

places.verdict: The modern bacaro that proves Venice's food scene isn't stuck in the past. Located on the local-feeling Via Garibaldi in Castello, Basegò brings contemporary flair to traditional cicchetti without losing the soul.

comparison.best for: Modern twist on cicchetti in Venice's most local-feeling neighborhood
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 850 reviews · Creative modern cicchetti · Away from tourist crowds · Via Garibaldi is Venice's liveliest local street
comparison.limitations: Slightly pricier than old-school bàcari · Closed Mondays · Far from Rialto/San Marco
comparison.what to order: Their seasonal crostini rotate, but the meat and cheese boards are also excellent. Good craft beer and wine selection.
comparison.insider tip: Via Garibaldi itself is worth the trip — one of the few wide, tree-lined streets in Venice, full of local shops and no tourist groups.

places.whatToOrder: Their seasonal crostini rotate, but the meat and cheese boards are also excellent. Good craft beer and wine selection.

places.name: Vino Vero
places.address: Fondamenta de la Misericordia, 2497, 30100 Venezia VE

redditQuotes.text: Recommended by the team at Hotel Flora, Vino Vero is a gem in the Cannaregio district. They are known for their incredible selection of high-quality, natural wines from small producers.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: The best wine bar in Venice for natural wine lovers. Incredible selection from small Italian and European producers, paired with thoughtful cicchetti. The Cannaregio canal-side setting is magical at sunset.

comparison.best for: Natural wine enthusiasts who want quality cicchetti with a curated wine list
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ from 3,032 reviews · Exceptional natural wine selection · Canal-side location on Fondamenta della Misericordia · Knowledgeable staff
comparison.limitations: Pricier than old-school bàcari · Opens at 4 PM on Mondays · Wine-focused (cicchetti selection is smaller)
comparison.what to order: Ask for a natural wine recommendation based on your taste — the staff genuinely knows their list. Crostini pair beautifully with their lighter whites.
comparison.insider tip: Recommended by Hotel Flora concierges as a local gem. Go at sunset for the best canal-side light.

places.whatToOrder: Ask for a natural wine recommendation based on your taste — the staff genuinely knows their list. Crostini pair beautifully with their lighter whites.

places.name: Cantina Do Spade

redditQuotes.text: A bustling shop where you can eat indoors or outside. They have a large variety of options, both hot and cold, and a lot of polpette to choose from. Their baccalà is delicious and their wine is cheap.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: The best spot near Rialto for hot cicchetti. While most bàcari focus on cold crostini, Do Spade excels at fried polpette, hot baccalà preparations, and cooked dishes. A bustling, high-energy stop.

comparison.best for: Hot, fried cicchetti and polpette — the best non-crostini cicchetti near Rialto
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 3,898 reviews · Wide variety of hot and cold options · Both counter and indoor seating · Full menu also available
comparison.limitations: Can be crowded and chaotic · Slightly touristy due to Rialto location · Skip the sit-down menu and stick to cicchetti at the counter
comparison.what to order: Polpette (fried meatballs — try both meat and fish versions), baccalà mantecato, and whatever fried items look fresh. Cheap house wine.
comparison.insider tip: Stick to the counter for cicchetti — the sit-down restaurant side is less impressive and more expensive. Counter service is the authentic experience.

places.whatToOrder: Polpette (fried meatballs — try both meat and fish versions), baccalà mantecato, and whatever fried items look fresh. Cheap house wine.

places.name: Al Timon

redditQuotes.text: Set along the lively Fondamenta della Misericordia, a popular nightlife area amongst locals, Al Timon specializes in both Florentine and Venetian cuisine.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: The best cicchetti spot for evening vibes. Located on the lively Fondamenta della Misericordia — Venice's local nightlife strip — Al Timon serves good cicchetti and great steaks alongside canal-side tables that are perfect at aperitivo hour.

comparison.best for: Evening aperitivo with canal-side seating in Venice's local nightlife area
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ from 3,511 reviews · Canal-side outdoor tables · Cicchetti AND full meals · Venice's best evening atmosphere for locals
comparison.limitations: Closed Tuesdays · Opens at 4 PM (not a lunch option) · Can be loud in the evening · Fiorentina steak focus means cicchetti isn't the main event
comparison.what to order: Cicchetti and a glass of house wine for aperitivo. If you're staying for dinner, the Fiorentina steak is their signature dish.
comparison.insider tip: Fondamenta della Misericordia is where Venetians go at night — combine Al Timon with Vino Vero for the best Cannaregio evening crawl.

places.whatToOrder: Cicchetti and a glass of house wine for aperitivo. If you're staying for dinner, the Fiorentina steak is their signature dish.

places.name: Cantina Vecia Carbonera
places.address: Rio Terà de la Maddalena, 2329, 30121 Venezia VE

redditQuotes.text: Cantina Vecia Carbonera is a no-nonsense, zero-frills establishment that serves up a selection of classic cicchetti, perfect to accompany your €1.50 ombra.
redditQuotes.source: — Her Grand Tour · The Venetian Bar Crawl: A Definitive Guide to Bàcari, 2024

places.verdict: A no-nonsense, zero-frills bacaro in Cannaregio serving classic cicchetti at rock-bottom prices. No pretense, no tourists, just a worn counter and €1.50 ombre. The kind of place where the regulars know each other by name.

comparison.best for: The most authentically local bacaro experience — zero tourist polish
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 1,034 reviews · Very cheap · Genuinely local crowd · Classic cicchetti done right · Long hours (10:30 AM – 9:30 PM)
comparison.limitations: Very basic setup · Small selection compared to bigger bàcari · Cannaregio location requires some walking
comparison.what to order: Classic cicchetti — baccalà, polpette, simple crostini. An ombra (small glass of wine) for €1.50 is the move.
comparison.insider tip: Combine with Vino Vero and Al Timon for a complete Cannaregio crawl. This is the cheap-and-cheerful warmup stop.

places.whatToOrder: Classic cicchetti — baccalà, polpette, simple crostini. An ombra (small glass of wine) for €1.50 is the move.

places.name: Osteria Bancogiro
places.address: Campo S. Giacomo di Rialto, 122, 30125 Venezia VE

redditQuotes.text: Osteria Bancogiro is a perfect spot to enjoy Venetian cicchetti with a view. Located along the Grand Canal, this charming osteria offers a solid selection of crostini and cocktails.
redditQuotes.source: — The Travel Folk · Best Cicchetti in Venice guide, 2025

places.verdict: The cicchetti spot with the best view. Sitting right on the Grand Canal near the Rialto Bridge, Bancogiro offers a solid cicchetti and wine selection with a view that most Venice restaurants charge €50+ to enjoy. Smart move: order cicchetti at the bar, grab an outdoor table.

comparison.best for: Grand Canal views with cicchetti and cocktails — the "wow factor" stop
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 2,056 reviews · Grand Canal location · Both cicchetti and full sit-down menu · Outdoor seating with incredible views
comparison.limitations: Pricier than hidden bàcari · Closed Mondays · Tourist-adjacent location · The restaurant food gets mixed reviews
comparison.what to order: Crostini, a spritz or glass of wine, and enjoy the view. Skip the full restaurant menu and keep it simple with bar snacks.
comparison.insider tip: Go for afternoon aperitivo (4–6 PM) — the light on the Grand Canal is perfect and it's less crowded than the dinner rush. The upstairs terrace has the best views.

places.whatToOrder: Crostini, a spritz or glass of wine, and enjoy the view. Skip the full restaurant menu and keep it simple with bar snacks.
